faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about BSofts School
faq.a1: BSofts School is a complete SaaS school management platform that handles students, teachers, parents, payments, attendance, exams, and more — all in one place.
faq.a2: Yes! We offer a free tier that supports up to 50 students and 5 teachers, perfect for small schools getting started.
faq.a3: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately and we prorate the difference.
faq.a4: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption, automated backups, and role-based access controls. Your data is hosted on secure cloud infrastructure.
faq.a5: Yes! All plans include email support. Premium and Enterprise plans get priority support with dedicated account managers.
